scripts.setup: npm ci && npm ci --prefix api && npm ci --prefix mobile
scripts.bootstrap: npm run setup && npm run dev:prepare
scripts.lint: npm --prefix api run lint && npm --prefix mobile run lint
scripts.lint:fix: npm --prefix api run lint:fix && npm --prefix mobile run lint:fix
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix api run typecheck && npm --prefix mobile run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix api run test -- --runInBand && npm --prefix mobile run test -- --runInBand
scripts.build: npm --prefix api run build && npm --prefix mobile run build
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run workflows:check && npm run automation:test && npm run lint
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run contracts:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.verify:full: npm run verify && npm run test:e2e:local && npm run test:journey:local
